The station is at 28.0405, -99.354. The latitude difference is 0.24 degrees, about 16.6 miles. The longitude difference is 1.9575 degrees. At latitude 27.9, one degree of longitude is about 69.17 × cos(27.9°) = 69.17 × 0.8836 ≈ 61.1 miles, so the longitude gap is about 119.6 miles. The total distance is roughly 120 miles, well over the 25-mile limit.

The gallons (43) are under the tank limit of 110, so capacity is not an issue. The location mismatch alone triggers a hold.
